items.source:
Convert an exception thrown by a tool to a String that can be sent back to the AI
model or throw an exception to be handled by the caller.
items.translation: 将工具抛出的异常转换为可返回给 AI 模型的字符串，或抛出由调用者处理的异常。

items.source: Uses of ToolExecutionException in org.springframework.ai.tool.execution
items.translation: ToolExecutionException 在 org.springframework.ai.tool.execution 中的用途
